SPAN_TYPES = ("DEL", "DUP", "INV", "CNV")


def spec_end(pos: int, ref: str, alt: str, info: str) -> int:
    """Last reference base covered by a record, per the VCF specification."""
    fields = dict()
    for item in info.split(";"):
        if "=" in item:
            k, v = item.split("=", 1)
            fields.setdefault(k, v)
    end = pos + len(ref) - 1                       # REF and non-symbolic ALTs
    if "END" in fields and fields["END"] != ".":   # deprecated END / <*> blocks
        end = max(end, int(fields["END"]))
    svlens = fields.get("SVLEN", "").split(",")
    for i, allele in enumerate(alt.split(",")):    # SVLEN is Number=A
        if i >= len(svlens):
            break
        if not (allele.startswith("<") and allele.endswith(">")):
            continue
        first_level = allele[1:-1].split(":")[0]
        if first_level not in SPAN_TYPES:
            continue                               # <INS>, <*>, <NON_REF>, ...
        try:
            svlen = int(svlens[i])
        except ValueError:
            continue                               # missing "." value
        end = max(end, pos + abs(svlen))
    return end


def write_vcf(path: Path) -> None:
    lines = [
        "##fileformat=VCFv4.5",
        f"##contig=<ID={CONTIG},length={CONTIG_LEN}>",
        '##ALT=<ID=DEL,Description="Deletion">',
        '##ALT=<ID=DUP,Description="Duplication">',
        '##ALT=<ID=INV,Description="Inversion">',
        '##ALT=<ID=CNV,Description="Copy number variable region">',
        '##ALT=<ID=INS,Description="Insertion">',
        '##ALT=<ID=NON_REF,Description="Represents any possible alternative allele">',
        '##ALT=<ID=*,Description="Represents allele(s) other than observed">',
        '##INFO=<ID=SVLEN,Number=A,Type=Integer,Description="Length of structural variant">',
        '##INFO=<ID=SVLEN2,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Decoy tag">',
        '##INFO=<ID=MYSVLEN,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Decoy tag">',
        '##INFO=<ID=SVCLAIM,Number=A,Type=String,Description="Structural variant claim">',
        '##INFO=<ID=CN,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Copy number">',
        '##INFO=<ID=END,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="End position (deprecated)">',
        "#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO",
    ]
    for rid, pos, ref, alt, info in RECORDS:
        lines.append("\t".join([CONTIG, str(pos), rid, ref, alt, ".", "PASS", info]))
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="ascii")


def run(cmd: list[str]) -> str:
    done = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    if done.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"command failed: {' '.join(map(str, cmd))}\n{done.stderr}")
    return done.stdout


def queried_ids(gz: Path, start: int, end: int) -> set[str]:
    out = run([str(TABIX), str(gz), f"{CONTIG}:{start}-{end}"])
    return {line.split("\t")[2] for line in out.splitlines() if line and not line.startswith("#")}


def main() -> int:
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    vcf = WORK / "spans.vcf"
    write_vcf(vcf)

    spans = {rid: (pos, spec_end(pos, ref, alt, info))
             for rid, pos, ref, alt, info in RECORDS}

    queries: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    for pos, end in spans.values():
        for probe in (pos - 1, pos, pos + 1, (pos + end) // 2, end - 1, end, end + 1):
            if probe >= 1:
                queries.append((probe, probe))
    for pos, end in spans.values():                 # windows, not just points
        queries.append((max(1, pos - 5), pos - 1))
        queries.append((end + 1, end + 10))
        queries.append((pos, end))
    queries = sorted(set(queries))

    failures = 0
    for label, extra in (("tbi", []), ("csi", ["-C"])):
        gz = WORK / f"spans.{label}.vcf.gz"
        run([str(BGZIP), "-f", "-c", str(vcf)])
        gz.write_bytes(subprocess.run([str(BGZIP), "-c", str(vcf)], capture_output=True,
                                      check=True).stdout)
        run([str(TABIX), "-f", "-p", "vcf", *extra, str(gz)])
        for start, end in queries:
            want = {rid for rid, (rpos, rend) in spans.items()
                    if rpos <= end and rend >= start}
            got = queried_ids(gz, start, end)
            if want != got:
                failures += 1
                print(f"MISMATCH [{label}] {CONTIG}:{start}-{end} "
                      f"missing={sorted(want - got)} unexpected={sorted(got - want)}")
    print(f"records={len(RECORDS)} queries={len(queries)} index_types=2 "
          f"comparisons={2 * len(queries)} failures={failures}")
    for rid, (pos, end) in spans.items():
        print(f"  span {rid:<15} {CONTIG}:{pos}-{end}  (rlen={end - pos + 1})")
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check that rlen is recomputed correctly when a record is modified in memory."""
import subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/svlen")
from gen_and_check import RECORDS, spec_end, WORK

PROBE = "/tmp/svlen/rlen_probe"

def drop(info, key):
    return ";".join(i for i in info.split(";") if i.split("=")[0] != key) or "."

def expect(rid, pos, ref, alt, info):
    n_alt = len(alt.split(","))
    no_end = drop(info, "END")
    steps = {
        "read": info,
        "same-alleles": info,
        "no-END": no_end,
        "END-plus-4000": f"{no_end};END={pos + 4000}" if no_end != "." else f"END={pos + 4000}",
        "no-END-again": no_end,
        "no-SVLEN": drop(no_end, "SVLEN"),
        "SVLEN-minus-321": (lambda base: (f"{base};" if base != "." else "")
                            + "SVLEN=" + ",".join(["-321"] * n_alt))(drop(no_end, "SVLEN")),
    }
    return {step: spec_end(pos, ref, alt, i) - pos + 1 for step, i in steps.items()}

wanted = {}
for rid, pos, ref, alt, info in RECORDS:
    wanted[rid] = expect(rid, pos, ref, alt, info)

out = subprocess.run([PROBE, str(WORK / "spans.vcf"), "update"],
                     text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
if out.stderr.strip():

checked = failures = 0
for line in out.stdout.splitlines():
    rid, step, rlen = line.split("\t")
    want = wanted[rid][step]
    checked += 1
    if int(rlen) != want:
        failures += 1
        print(f"MISMATCH {rid} {step}: got rlen={rlen} want {want}")
print(f"records={len(RECORDS)} steps_checked={checked} failures={failures}")
raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)

## Diagnosis

The snapshot was upstream htslib with the VCF 4.4/4.5 **`INFO/SVLEN` reference-span** logic removed — no C source mentioned `SVLEN`. A `<DEL>` record whose length is given only by `SVLEN` (no deprecated `END`) was therefore indexed and filtered as covering just `POS`, so it vanished from any interior query while the query at `POS` still matched — exactly the "superficially healthy" failure described.

The local specification (`paper.md`) states the rule that was missing:
- §1.6.1: "END of each allele … `<DEL>`, `<DUP>`, `<INV>`, and `<CNV>` symbolic structural variant alleles: POS + SVLEN"; `<INS>`/non-symbolic: `POS + len(REF) − 1`; `<*>`: last reference call position.
- Table 1/§6.3.1: rlen "must be the maximum of the length of the REF allele and the lengths inferred from the SVLEN/END of any symbolic alleles" and "is important when indexing VCF/BCF files".
- SVLEN is `Number=A` (one value per ALT), "the absolute value of SVLEN should be taken", missing values inferred from `END`, and subtypes (`<DEL:ME>`, `<CNV:TR>`) "do not change … interpretation".

## Fix (3 files, no fixture-specific values)

- **`source/vcf.c`** — `svlen_defines_span()` (first-level type ∈ DEL/DUP/INV/CNV, subtypes allowed), `vcf_svlen_ref_span()` (text, per-allele), `bcf_svlen_ref_span()` (parsed record), `bcf_sync_rlen()` = max(len REF, END, SVLEN); wired into `vcf_parse_info()`, `_bcf1_sync_alleles()` and `bcf_update_info()` (END/SVLEN add *and* removal), with overflow clamping.
- **`source/tbx.c`** — the tabix text path (used for both index building and iterator filtering) now captures ALT and extends the interval by the shared helper's span.
- **`source/hts_internal.h`** — declares the helper shared by both paths so index and query can never disagree.
